Where do you belong?

Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. Whether you’re a clinician, or non-clinical professional, at USACS you'll feel a sense of connection working with clinicians and office staff who share your interests and values. We want you to love coming to work each day because you believe in what you do and the people with whom you work. We care about your success.

USACS also understands that location is important. We offer career opportunities for clinicians and non-clinical support staff from New York to Hawaii and numerous points in between. Our supportive culture, outstanding benefits and competitive compensation package is best in class.

Job Description

The Clinical Informatics Analyst will support the Operation Analytics & Clinical Informatics department by translating business needs into analytical solutions that improve healthcare delivery, operational efficiency, and clinical outcomes. This role involves gathering and analyzing healthcare data, developing data models and reports, and working cross-functionally to identify actionable insights. The analyst will collaborate with clinical, operational, and technical teams to deliver data-driven solutions that align with the organization’s strategic goals.

Essential Job Functions

Evaluates information gathered from multiple sources, reconciles conflicts, decomposes high-level information into details, abstracts up from low-level information to a general understanding, and distinguishes user requests from the underlying true needs.
Collaborates with clinical and operational stakeholders to define business needs and translate them into detailed data and reporting requirements.
Collects, analyzes, and interprets healthcare and operational data from multiple sources, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.
Develops reports, dashboards, and visualizations using tools such as SQL, Excel, Power BI, or Tableau to support decision-making across departments.
Works with data engineering and IT teams to validate data pipelines and ensure the integrity, quality, and consistency of data.
Supports data governance and standardization efforts within the department to ensure consistent definitions and usage of healthcare metrics.
Facilitates meetings, workshops, and presentations with key stakeholders to share findings and gather feedback.
Creates clear documentation of analytical methods, data sources, and assumptions to support reproducibility and transparency of analysis.
Conducts root cause analysis on variances in clinical or operational performance.
Participates in the planning, development, and deployment of new analytics initiatives, tools, and solutions.
Stays up-to-date with trends in healthcare analytics, informatics, and regulatory reporting to ensure alignment with industry standards.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Knowledge of and experience in software development with special focus in Enterprise Data Warehousing.
Excellent communication, professional, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
Proven analytical, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Solid understanding of healthcare operations, clinical workflows, or population health data.
Strong SQL skills and familiarity with querying complex datasets from data warehouses or clinical data repositories.
Proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or similar platforms.
Ability to communicate effectively with clinical and non-clinical stakeholders and translate data into actionable insights.
Knowledge of healthcare terminologies (ICD, CPT, DRG, LOINC, etc.) and data standards (HL7, FHIR) is preferred.
Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and the ability to work independently or in a team setting.
Demonstrated experience in identifying key performance indicators (KPIs) and designing metrics for operational tracking.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.
Understanding of data privacy and security standards, including HIPAA compliance.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Public Health, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Data Analyst in a healthcare or clinical analytics environment.
Experience working with clinical data (EHRs, claims, billing, etc.) and large-scale data systems in a healthcare setting is highly desirable.
Exposure to healthcare quality reporting, regulatory requirements (e.g., CMS, HEDIS), or clinical outcome analysis is a plus.

Physical Dimensions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for prolonged periods and occasionally walk, stand, bend, stoop, and lift up to 15 pounds.
Required to have close visual acuity to perform job functions such as reviewing reports, dashboards, and spreadsheets.

jobs.title: SAS Data Analyst I or II – Health Data Research
jobs.description:
Job Summary

NORC at the University of Chicago is seeking a qualified Data Analyst I or II (we are open to hiring at either level) to join the Health Sciences Department to support hospital discharge data processing across states and harmonizing and packaging files into a uniform format. At NORC, Data Analysts are early career team members who train and work with our senior Research Scientists, Statisticians, and Data Scientists to perform tasks such as data processing, quality assurance, analysis, and dissemination.

As part of their data processing responsibilities, Data Analysts import, clean, standardize, transform, and validate data sets. They also research and document data procedures and support the investigation of data problems. They may identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in data sets, and help prepare data presentations and reports, including developing charts, graphs, and tables. In addition, the Data Analyst may assist in data collection and harmonization from primary or secondary data sources (e.g., administrative records, commercial data, social media data), preparing data files for delivery, and the maintenance of databases, data systems, and their relevant metadata/dictionaries. The Data Analyst is expected to work collaboratively in a team environment.

For this role, proficiency in SAS is a requirement. Experience with R or Python is welcome but not essential. Prior work with healthcare or administrative claims data is preferred, and strong documentation practices are important.

Qualified applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Location : This is a hybrid role based in either our Chicago Loop or downtown DC office, with a minimum of six days per month in the office. Exceptional remote candidates may be considered as well.

DEPARTMENT: Health Science Research

NORC’s Health Sciences staff produce rich data on social priorities including child development and healthy aging, the uses of electronic clinical data in research, and the applications and effectiveness of health information technology.

The Health Sciences team is versatile and experienced in data acquisition, management, technical assistance, and analysis; the use of information technology in health care; and numerous data collection methods. Our track record of leadership and innovation includes the design and management of large-scale surveys, including extensive experience collecting biomeasures.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with researchers, statisticians, data scientists, technology experts, and subject matter experts to implement and improve data management, processing, and analysis activities.
Develop programs and scripts for data cleaning, integration, transformation, and harmonization, as well as data quality checks and validation
Support and enhance applications and databases already built for various research needs and produce data documentation and dictionaries.
Contribute to documentation, reports, and presentations through writing sections, creating basic analytic summaries, and developing tables and graphics.
Apply AI tools to help improve efficiency.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills

Bachelor’s degree in one of the following fields: quantitative social sciences, public health, statistics, biostatistics, health informatics, math, data science, or computer science, or related field required.
Proficiency with data management and data processing.
0-2 years’ experience in positions of increasing responsibility, preferably working with large data sets, and conducting statistical/analytic programming (internships included).
Strong foundation in areas of statistics, mathematics, and data science.
Proficient coding skills in SAS are required, including experience with SAS macros
Additional experience with R or Python is welcome but not essential.
Prior work with healthcare or administrative claims data is preferred.
Strong skills in problem solving and quantitative analysis are required. Able to organize and prioritize work assignments to meet project needs.
Outstanding interpersonal and critical reasoning skills.
Proficiency with MS Office software.

Please include a Resume and Cover Letter when applying. Candidates should be prepared to provide professional references upon request.

Salary And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $62,000 –
$77,000.

Benefits

This position is classified as regular. Regular staff are eligible for NORC’s comprehensive benefits program. Benefits include, but are not limited to:

Generously subsidized health insurance, effective on the first day of employment
Dental and vision insurance
A defined contribution retirement program, along with a separate voluntary 403(b) retirement program
Group life insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance
Benefits that promote work/life balance, including generous paid time off, holidays; paid parental leave, bereavement leave, tuition assistance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

NORC is committed to equity and transparency in its pay practices. We publish salary ranges and benefit information for every job. The listed hiring range reflects what we, in good faith, expect to pay at the time of posting, though actual compensation may vary and may be adjusted over time. A candidate’s placement within the range depends on factors such as competencies, education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and organizational needs.

What We Do

NORC at the University of Chicago is an objective, non-partisan research institution that delivers reliable data and rigorous analysis to guide critical programmatic, business, and policy decisions. Since 1941, our teams have conducted groundbreaking studies, created and applied innovative methods and tools, and advanced principles of scientific integrity and collaboration. Today, government, corporate, and nonprofit clients around the world partner with us to transform increasingly complex information into useful knowledge.

Who We Are

For over 80 years, NORC has evolved in many ways, moving the needle with research methods, technical applications and groundbreaking research findings. But our tradition of excellence, passion for innovation, and commitment to collegiality have remained constant components of who we are as a brand, and who each of us is as a member of the NORC team. With world-class benefits, a business casual environment, and an emphasis on continuous learning, NORC is a place where people join for the stellar research and analysis work for which we’re known, and stay for the relationships they form with their colleagues who take pride in the impact their work is making on a global scale.

NORC is an equal opportunity employer. NORC evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, sexual orientation, and other legally protected characteristics.

About The Role

We are seeking an entry-level Business Intelligence Data Engineer (T1) to join our BI team. In this role, you will help build and maintain data pipelines that move information from manufacturing and business systems into reporting tools. You will assist in tracking end-to-end data lineage, supporting data validation checks, and maintaining documentation for SOX compliance. This role serves as a functional connector between IT and internal business teams to support reliable reporting across the company.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that move and transform data from source systems (e.g., ERP, MES, supply chain, finance) into reporting-ready datasets.
Document and maintain data lineage from source systems through transformations to dashboards and reports.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and usability of key business metrics, including validation checks and reconciliation.
Build and maintain SOX-compliant data processes, including change management, access controls, audit trails, and documentation.
Work closely with IT, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and other departments to understand business processes and translate them into reliable data solutions.
Act as a bridge between technical and business teams, clarifying data definitions and resolving data quality issues.
Manage work through Jira and follow version-control best practices in Git.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
1-2 years of experience in data engineering, BI, or a related role.
Proficiency in writing foundational Python scripts and using pandas for data manipulation.Strong baseline SQL skills (joining tables, writing aggregations, subqueries, and standard transformations).
Familiarity with version control using Git and task tracking via Jira.
Understanding of basic data modeling concepts, data lineage, and data quality assurance methods.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with an eagerness to collaborate across business functions.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with manufacturing, supply chain, or inventory accounting workflows.
Exposure to ERP environments (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
General awareness of SOX compliance, internal controls, or audit preparation requirements.

As a globally recognized brand, Zicasso maintains a strong reputation among discerning travelers and is frequently featured in leading media outlets such as The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, BBC, Forbes, CNN, and Condé Nast Traveler. Our fully remote operational model spans five continents, fostering a dynamic and progressive work environment that values creativity, initiative, and continuous learning. We are committed to professional growth and cultural enrichment through biannual international retreats and summits, which serve as opportunities for collaboration, idea sharing, and destination immersion.

Join Zicasso to be part of a forward-thinking company that aims to shape the future of luxury travel while promoting a connected and inspired global community through travel experiences.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Marketing Data Analyst to join our remote team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for uncovering actionable marketing insights that influence strategic decision-making and drive business growth. Your expertise will support various functions including marketing, product development, and customer experience by analyzing complex datasets, designing comprehensive reporting frameworks, and evaluating campaign performance.

About Us (and Our Exciting Future)

Menasha Corporation is all about possibilities. Our two businesses, Menasha Packaging and ORBIS Corporation, are leaders in their industries, providing corrugated and plastic packaging products and related services to major global companies.

About The Opportunity

The Supply Chain Project Manager serves as the primary liaison between Menasha Packaging and its customers for order and inventory management along with supply chain–related initiatives. This role is responsible for coordinating and managing customer orders, inventory liability and ongoing supply chain initiatives, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and execution across internal teams and external partners.

This position focuses on orchestrating people, activities, and decisions across Sales, Operations, Logistics, Procurement, and Finance to ensure customer commitments are met and initiatives move forward smoothly.

Track progress, surface issues, and ensure follow‑through on commitments.

Partner closely with Sales, Operations, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Planning teams to align execution with customer requirements.
Facilitate discussions to resolve tradeoffs between cost, service, capacity, and timing.
Ensure internal teams are aligned on priorities and customer expectations.

Communication & Issue Management

Provide clear, proactive communication to customers and internal stakeholders on order or initiative status, risks, and next steps.
Identify potential issues early and work collaboratively to resolve them.
Escalate risks or misalignment appropriately while proposing practical solutions.

Supply Chain Insight & Support

Understand Menasha Packaging’s supply chain capabilities, constraints, and options well enough to guide decision‑making.
Support analysis related to logistics, capacity, lead times, and service impacts as needed (without owning deep technical modeling).
Assist with post‑run reviews to ensure objectives are met and lessons learned are captured.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve how Menasha manages customer‑driven supply chain initiatives.
Share best practices and lessons learned across the organization.
Help refine communication and coordination processes between customers and internal teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
2+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, operations, customer management, or related roles within a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Experience working directly with customers on order management, supply chain or operational initiatives.
Strong coordination, communication, and organizational skills.
Ability to influence and align stakeholders without direct authority.
Comfort operating in a fast‑paced, ambiguous environment.
Experience in packaging, manufacturing, or industrial supply chains.
Exposure to logistics, warehousing, transportation, or planning functions.
Experience supporting new product launches, customer transitions, or network changes.
Familiarity with basic supply chain metrics and financial tradeoffs.

Critical Competencies

Relationship‑oriented and customer‑focused
Strong communicator and facilitator
Execution‑focused with high accountability
Pragmatic problem solver
Ability to balance customer needs with internal realities

Travel

Occasional travel (10–20%) to customer locations, manufacturing sites, or warehouses as needed.

Two companies, one vision.

Menasha Corporation consists of two companies that are leading the way to a sustainable future with packaging and supply chain solutions. Founded in 1849 and headquartered in Neenah, Wisconsin, we employ over 7,500 employees in 112 facilities in North America and Europe.

Our companies are leading corrugated and plastic packaging manufacturers and supply chain solution providers. Our Menasha Packaging Company is the largest independent provider of packaging and supply chain service solutions in North America, designing, printing, and fulfilling graphic packaging, display and merchandising solutions for over 1,800 brands, both in-store and online.

Our ORBIS business believes there is a better way to optimize today’s supply chains, with reusable packaging products and services. Reusable containers, pallets, dunnage, bulk systems and metal racks improve the flow product all along the supply chain to reduce costs, enhance profitability and add sustainability.

Our products and services are used by global, name-brand companies in the food, beverage, health and beauty, over-the-counter pharmaceutical, industrial, automotive, and electronics industries.

Come build an exciting, rewarding career with us, where you’ll have opportunities to grow.

The possibilities are endless. The power is yours!

The Project Manager – Enterprise ensures that enterprise-level projects are executed on time, within scope, and within budget—while aligning with business objectives and maintaining stakeholder engagement across multiple departments and business units.

The Project Manager - Enterprise plans, executes, and delivers all projects on time, on budget, and within scope in accordance with business priorities. Throughout the lifecycle of each project, the manager tracks project status and manages project teams to mitigate issues and risks.

This role will interact regularly with members across NYBC Enterprises and departments (Example: Leadership Team, Finance, IT, Quality, Operations etc.) and key stakeholders for facilitating the efficient implementation and growth of the managed projects and programs. Requires self-direction, the ability to operate with ambiguity, and a level of perseverance to manage multiple iterations of tasks.

Responsibilities

Builds, leads, and coaches multiple project teams throughout project lifecycles across NYBC Enterprises divisions.
Define and create project plans for project and program prioritization and implementation.
Defines and coordinates the securing of commitments from cross-functional groups and external providers in terms of resources, cost, schedule, and performance.
Produces all relevant project management deliverables such as project objectives and requirements, risk assessments, project plans, project status reports, open issues log, change logs, action items list etc.; project risks will be escalated to sponsors on a timely basis for decision resolution and disposition.
Facilitate all operational checkpoint activities throughout the lifecycle of projects.
Assess and resolve all high-priority project risks as they are encountered.
Defines and leads strategy, implementation, operational planning/excellence, establishment, execution, and evaluation of multifaceted and cross-functional programs.
Ensure all projects adhere to project methodology compliance standards set by the company.
Continually update relevant business stakeholders of project status across enterprise.
Ensure all projects meet success parameters and ROI targets stated in business cases.
Ensure compliance with all aspects of policies, guidelines, practices, procedures, and regulations.
Tracks project status and manage project teams to mitigate issues and risks.
Acts as an intermediary between the business community and the technical community working with project teams and business clients to collect, clarify, and translate business requirements into documentation and conceptual design.
Works with organizational leaders to create and maintain an operating plan to achieve the strategic vision and operating platform that defines the people, processes, tools, and technologies as applicable.
Partners with business and technology partners to elicit, analyze, translate, and document business requirements into technical requirements as applicable.
Regularly updates relevant business stakeholders of project status.
Manages vendors, consultants, and developers to ensure appropriate documentation, process flows, specifications, and system testing.
Coordinates the project resources to ensure that projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Identify and acquire appropriate resources needed, ensuring availability necessary for project deliverables. Manage resources within respective departments, other internal departments, outside service providers, as well as materials committed to the projects.

Education

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration , Project Management, Information Systems, or related field.

Related Experience

7+ years of experience with multiple Project Management Methodologies (Six Sigma, Agile, Waterfall, PMBOK, Lean, etc.) in managing Enterprise level projects.
Demonstrated success in coordinating concurrent small, medium and /or large-scale projects and delivering on time and within budget.
Proven project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, and adapt to new projects rapidly and effectively in a matrix environment.
Experience and high proficiency with project management tools/software packages (ServiceNow, Smartsheet, MS Project, SharePoint, MS TEAMS, OneNote, Visio, Office 365, etc.)
Strong multitasking skills, able to shift focus and priorities, and reprioritize project portfolio as needed.
Experience in managing stakeholders.

Education may be substituted in lieu of extensive directly related professional experience.

Knowledge

Knowledge of project management and change management principles and practices.
Knowledge of the healthcare industry.
Knowledge of software requirements, test specifications, and computer systems validation.

Skills

Cultural competency and the ability to communicate effectively in a culturally sensitive manner with both individuals and groups from diverse backgrounds.
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Analytical mindset with data-driven decision-making skills.
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Asana).
Exceptional organizational and time management skills.
Problem solving and root cause identification skills along with strong analytic and decision-making abilities.
Excellent presentation skills are required.

Abilities

Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
Deep understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).
Ability to manage budgets, contracts, and vendor relationships.
Ability to use and analyze data to identify process improvement opportunities.
Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify and analyze the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems within established policies and procedures.
Ability to lead the work of several concurrent projects and work in a strong team environment.
Strong customer service orientation toward internal and external customers.
Ability to use personal influence to build positive working relationships with others.
Team player, collaborative, adaptable, and committed to quality.
Ability to conduct effective meetings.
Ability to prepare proposals, reports, and other written documents with strong attention to detail.
Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization.
Ability to be responsive and available to leadership teams to address issues and concerns as they arise.
Ability to provide the highest quality service to all customers. Must be able to multi-task proficiently.

Any combination of education, training, and experience equivalent to the requirements above that has supplied the necessary knowledge, skills, and experience to perform the essential functions of the job.

For applicants who will perform this position in Westchester County, the proposed annual salary is $127,000.00 to $137,000.00 per year. For applicants who will perform this position outside of New York City or Westchester County, salary will reflect local market rates and be commensurate with the applicant’s skills, job-related knowledge, and experience.

Overview

Founded in 1964, New York Blood Center Enterprises (NYBCe) has provided more than 60 years of lifesaving research, innovation, and impact. NYBCe is one of the largest nonprofit blood centers, operating in 16 states and serving 75 million people. NYBCe operates Blood Bank of Delmarva, Community Blood Center of Greater Kansas City, Connecticut Blood Center, Memorial Blood Centers, Nebraska Community Blood Bank, New Jersey Blood Services, New York Blood Center, and Rhode Island Blood Center, delivering more than one million blood products to nearly 550 U.S. hospitals annually. NYBCe additionally delivers cellular therapies, specialty pharmacy, and medical services to 200+ research, academic, and biopharmaceutical organizations. NYBCe’s Lindsley F. Kimball Research Institute is a leader in hematology and transfusion medicine research, dedicated to the study, prevention, treatment and cure of bloodborne and blood-related diseases. NYBCe is a vital community lifeline dedicated to helping patients and advancing global public health. To learn more, visit nybce.org . Connect with us on Facebook , X , Instagram , and LinkedIn .

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are 

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit www.marketbridge.com and follow www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/.

Who We're Looking For  

The successful candidate will be able to deliver on their commitments, demonstrating personal accountability for client projects and organizational achievements. You will take a leadership role in all projects you oversee, building strong internal relationships to work well across various agency stakeholders, including Account Management, Strategy, Creative, Media, Technology and Operations. 

You will be responsible for ensuring all projects are delivered on time, on budget & on brief. To be successful, you exude confidence and are eager to dig into the details. You thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments. You are adept at managing multiple projects and priorities and responding to last minute changes in direction without breaking a sweat. You are curious and embrace learning whether it’s new technology, data and analytics or PM best practices. You long to work with an amazing team of people who are experts in what they do. Experience in digital marketing would be considered an asset. 

Responsibilities

Project management 

You will be responsible for the planning, scheduling, resourcing, and implementation of a wide range of marketing initiatives. 
You will ensure each project is running smoothly by anticipating and effectively dealing with project issues and roadblocks. 
You will assist in preparing estimates, project documentation, schedules and status reports, as well as providing project administrative support as required. 
You will understand our internal processes and what our craft experts need to do their best work. 
You will work with the Account Managers and internal teams to ensure briefs are thorough, timelines are realistic and work is delivered within budget. 
You will ensure internal teams receive the direction and support they need to deliver successful work. 
You will be responsible for profitability with regards to how projects are managed and delivered. 

Client Delivery Team Partnership

You will work with the Client Success team as partners — bringing solutions and options to the table, not just status and risk
You will flag scope, budget, or timeline concerns the moment you see them, so no one is caught off guard
You will know when to hold a firm line on scope, budget, or quality, and can explain the reasoning clearly and professionally
At times, you will communicate directly with clients to keep projects moving efficiently and professionally

Workflow management 
You will demonstrate leadership amongst the organization to ensure implemented processes are being followed and support new ones as required 
You will be constantly looking for and identifying ways to better deliver on our promises  

Communications 
You ask questions early and often, driven by genuine curiosity about the client's business and strategic goals — not just the deliverable list. A well-timed question prevents a poorly-timed rework

You will clearly and consistently communicate goals, responsibilities, performance expectations and feedback in a positive and collaborative manner with internal teams
At times, you will be expected to communicate directly with clients in order to keep projects moving forward efficiently and professionally

Qualifications 

2+ years of related work experience and a post-secondary degree in Business, Marketing or equivalent. 
Demonstrated experience supporting multiple projects involving cross-functional teams within budgetary and schedule constraints. 
Experience supporting fully integrated marketing campaigns, including Marketing Automation and Media components 
Experience with Project Management tools such as Workbook, Scoro, Asana, ClickUp, etc
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
Someone who loves being part of an energetic, enthusiastic team, but also isn’t afraid to forge ahead independently when required. 
Genuine curiosity about the client's business and strategic goals — not just the deliverable list
Comfortable working within shared team standards and processes
Effective collaboration and leadership
A detail-oriented approach and excellent organizational skills
Experience running large, integrated media initiatives, and familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) for B2B, is a requirement
PMP certification is an asset

Our Culture & Our Core Values

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.  
How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day.  Be Kind
 means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another.  Be Open
 reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback.  Be Real 
speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves.  Be Brave
 pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results. 
You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through. 
Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows. 

Benefits & Perks 

At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to: 
🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug. 

💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness. 

💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind. 

📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career. 

💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis. 

Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours. 

We aim to offer competitive and equitable compensation based on factors such as location, relevant experience, skills, and market benchmarks. The anticipated salary range for this role is  $55,000 to $70,000. 

Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements.

new_jobs.title: Senior Website Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
This position is open to applicants in the US and Canada.

About Our Company

Kanopi Studios is a Design, Development & Support Agency with a fully distributed team of experts in Drupal & WordPress.

Our clients are mission-driven - and so are we. We design
, build
, and support
websites that help their missions thrive.

We believe the people behind the work matter just as much as the work itself. That's why we're deeply committed to supporting our team's growth, well-being, and success. When our people thrive, our clients do too - and together, we build a web that works better for everyone.

As Kanopi continues to grow, we're excited to welcome a new Senior Website Project Manager
to our team.

About The Job

We're looking for a process-driven Senior Website Project Manager
who brings structure and strategic oversight to every phase of a project and sets the standard for how our project management team works. This role focuses on managing the systems, workflows, and communications that keep client-facing Drupal and/or WordPress projects moving forward, ensuring clarity across teams, maintaining accurate project tracking, and continuously seeking opportunities to improve and streamline how we deliver high-quality digital work.

As a Senior Website Project Manager at Kanopi Studios, you'll guide a mix of Drupal and/or WordPress build and support projects from kickoff through completion, including some of our largest and most complex accounts. You're a client advocate and a strategic partner, and the problem-solver the team counts on when things get complicated. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams of UX/UI designers, developers, and strategists to ensure each project delivers quality, value, and a bit of Kanopi magic.

This senior-level role requires someone with extensive agency experience leading Drupal and/or WordPress projects. You bring a deep understanding of project life cycles, the judgment to flex between build initiatives and nimble support sprints, and the confidence to guide and mentor other project managers.

Requirements

As a Senior Website Project Manager, your typical day may include:

Client & Project Leadership

Manage a portfolio of projects across the build and support spectrum, including high-visibility accounts with complex technical and client needs
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for clients, ensuring smooth communication and exceptional service delivery
Understand each client's business needs and effectively communicate them to the internal team to ensure alignment
Know when to push back on behalf of Kanopi's best interests, when to escalate situations to Management, and how to resolve most issues independently before they reach that point
Proactively identify opportunities for larger projects and initiatives, and bring clear recommendations to the Management team
Gain a deep understanding of the client websites you manage so you can proactively recommend improvements
Lead client communications with clarity and empathy, facilitating meetings, demonstrating new features, articulating next steps, sharing updates, and translating technical concepts into plain language
Build positive, long-lasting relationships that encourage contract renewals and account growth

Planning & Execution

Lead project and client onboarding, kickoff calls, and transitions between build and support
Curate and maintain organized, prioritized backlogs that keep project teams focused and work moving forward
Critically evaluate tasks and client requests for strategic fit with client goals and project scope, recommending alternatives when needed
Personally handle "quick win" Drupal and/or WordPress site configurations, content entry, and initial bug troubleshooting before escalating to the development team.
Collaborate with clients and internal teams to resolve blockers and anticipate needs
Forecast and coordinate internal resources, including front-end and back-end developers, UX/UI designers, and strategists, based on timing, scope, and expertise

Quality, Budget, and Timeline Oversight

Review completed work (designs, tickets, content, and development) to ensure it meets Kanopi's quality standards before client handoff
Monitor and forecast budgets and timelines to ensure tasks are completed on time and within scope, while providing regular updates to clients and Kanopi management on hours used and project progress
Flag risks early and lead the team in resolving and mitigating issues
Expedite urgent requests, triage issues quickly, and manage escalations, particularly within support accounts

Tools & Team Collaboration

Use tools like Teamwork, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and Claude to stay organized and maintain transparency
Use AI tools like Claude to speed up everyday project work, such as drafting client communications, summarizing meetings, writing tickets, and preparing status updates, while reviewing everything for accuracy before it goes out
Participate in and help lead team meetings, standups, retrospectives, and collaborative discussions that drive ongoing process improvements and a positive team culture
Monitor team workloads and pacing to help maintain a sustainable, healthy balance, identifying early signs of strain or burnout in yourself and others and proactively adjusting priorities when needed
Build and document repeatable processes that improve project success and team satisfaction
Mentor and support other project managers, sharing best practices and serving as a go-to resource for the PM team

About The Compensation And Work Requirements

This is a full-time position. The starting salary for this role will fall within the range of $75,400.00 - $93,668.00. This range reflects the full good-faith range we reasonably expect to pay for this role across all eligible locations; where you fall within it will depend on your experience and skills, in alignment with current members of our team in similar roles.

This is a 100% remote role. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the US or Canada and be available for regular collaboration during Pacific Time Zone business hours. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Now, let's talk about you!

We Are Looking For Candidates Who...

Have 5+ years of digital agency project management experience, including leading Drupal and/or WordPress projects
Have a proven track record managing the full life cycle of web build projects, as well as long-term client support engagements
Are fluent in agile workflows, ticketing systems, and client documentation, and can help teams stay focused and aligned
Are proficient with AI tools like Claude and use them regularly to improve how you plan, communicate, and manage projects
Have hands-on experience troubleshooting bugs, working with site configurations, and managing content in Drupal and/or WordPress
Have a strong working knowledge of best practices in website performance, configuration, and development fundamentals
Know how to balance scope, timelines, and budgets without compromising quality or team morale
Have excellent time management skills to stay on top of your own workload and that of the team members you manage
Have experience forecasting and resourcing development project needs, and understand how to match the right roles to project requirements
Can set clear priorities, communicate shifts effectively, and keep both internal teams and clients in sync
Are proactive, empathetic and confident communicators who listen deeply, explain clearly, and follow through consistently
Stay organized and calm while managing multiple active projects, keeping attention to detail and communication steady as priorities shift
Bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to day-to-day delivery, risk mitigation, issue tracking, change management, and escalations
Possess strong problem-solving skills, emotional intelligence, and initiative, and genuinely enjoy helping others succeed
Have experience mentoring or guiding other project managers or team members
Have a passion for the web, for open source software like Drupal and WordPress, and for working with a bunch of fun, thoughtful people
Have experience managing and working with distributed project teams and thrive in a remote-first, collaborative environment
Are available to work during core Pacific Time Zone hours

Studies show that some candidates, particularly women and people from underrepresented communities, only apply for a job when they meet every listed qualification. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't line up perfectly with every point above, we'd still love to hear from you.

Kanopi is committed to an inclusive team.

At Kanopi, we know that a diverse team makes us stronger, more creative, and more effective, and we enthusiastically welcome applicants of all backgrounds. Kanopi Studios is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, provincial, territorial, or local law.

Now, What?

If you think this post was written just for you, here's what to do next:

Use the ‘Apply for this Job' button located toward the bottom of the page
Fill out all required fields on the Application page
Upload your resume
Upload your optional cover letter. Note: Some folks feel that cover letters are no longer important to hiring teams. Please be assured that Kanopi looks forward to reading yours! We'd love to hear what makes you a great fit for this role!

What to expect after you apply:

We want to make sure we're a great fit - for you and for us! Here's what our process looks like:

Application review: We'll take time to carefully review your application
Initial questions: If we'd like to learn more, we'll send a short set of questions to get to know you better
Interviews and skills assessment:
You'll meet with several team members to chat about the role and your experience
You may be given the opportunity to complete a couple of short tasks designed to show us how you approach your work

We'll explain each step more fully as you move through the process. We're excited to get to know you!

Please note: We make an effort to contact every applicant to let you know the status of your application, but we are human, so if you don't hear from us, drop us a line!

Kanopi Studios is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

How We Use AI In Our Hiring Process.

In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we use artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist our hiring team in reviewing job applications. Specifically, AI tools may be used to anonymize applications to mitigate potential bias and to assist in the initial assessment of qualifications against the criteria listed in this posting.

AI is never the sole basis for a decision. All selection decisions are made with human review and oversight, and no applicant is rejected solely by an AI-based tool. We regularly review our processes and the tools we use to monitor for accuracy and potential bias, and to ensure alignment with the fair treatment of applicants and with applicable federal, state, and local law.

Hiring Transparency Notice

This job posting reflects an active vacancy at Kanopi Studios
The expected compensation range for this role is listed in the job posting and may vary based on experience and skills
Artificial intelligence (AI) may be used to assist in reviewing applications as part of the hiring process. All selection decisions include human review and oversig

As Kanopi continues to grow, we're excited to welcome a new Senior Website Project Manager
to our team.

About The Job

We're looking for a process-driven Senior Website Project Manager
who brings structure and strategic oversight to every phase of a project and sets the standard for how our project management team works. This role focuses on managing the systems, workflows, and communications that keep client-facing Drupal and/or WordPress projects moving forward, ensuring clarity across teams, maintaining accurate project tracking, and continuously seeking opportunities to improve and streamline how we deliver high-quality digital work.

As a Senior Website Project Manager at Kanopi Studios, you'll guide a mix of Drupal and/or WordPress build and support projects from kickoff through completion, including some of our largest and most complex accounts. You're a client advocate and a strategic partner, and the problem-solver the team counts on when things get complicated. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams of UX/UI designers, developers, and strategists to ensure each project delivers quality, value, and a bit of Kanopi magic.

You bring a deep understanding of project life cycles, the judgment to flex between build initiatives and nimble support sprints, and the confidence to guide and mentor other project managers.

Requirements

As a Senior Website Project Manager, your typical day may include:

Client & Project Leadership

Manage a portfolio of projects across the build and support spectrum, including high-visibility accounts with complex technical and client needs
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for clients, ensuring smooth communication and exceptional service delivery

Proactively identify opportunities for larger projects and initiatives, and bring clear recommendations to the Management team
Gain a deep understanding of the client websites you manage so you can proactively recommend improvements
Lead client communications with clarity and empathy, facilitating meetings, demonstrating new features, articulating next steps, sharing updates, and translating technical concepts into plain language

Planning & Execution

Collaborate with clients and internal teams to resolve blockers and anticipate needs
Forecast and coordinate internal resources, including front-end and back-end developers, UX/UI designers, and strategists, based on timing, scope, and expertise

Quality, Budget, and Timeline Oversight

Review completed work (designs, tickets, content, and development) to ensure it meets Kanopi's quality standards before client handoff
Monitor and forecast budgets and timelines to ensure tasks are completed on time and within scope, while providing regular updates to clients and Kanopi management on hours used and project progress
Flag risks early and lead the team in resolving and mitigating issues
Expedite urgent requests, triage issues quickly, and manage escalations, particularly within support accounts

Tools & Team Collaboration

Use tools like Teamwork, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and Claude to stay organized and maintain transparency

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Now, let's talk about you!

We Are Looking For Candidates Who...

Have 5+ years of digital agency project management experience, including leading Drupal and/or WordPress projects
Have a proven track record managing the full life cycle of web build projects, as well as long-term client support engagements
Are fluent in agile workflows, ticketing systems, and client documentation, and can help teams stay focused and aligned

Futurum Research, part of The Futurum Group, delivers independent, data-driven insights to help technology leaders make better decisions. Futurum’s custom research work is commissioned by leading technology vendors (Fortune 500 and quickly-growing startups) across industries and technology sectors, helping to guide their internal strategy, educate the market, and demonstrate their value—based on a foundation of objective, independent data, analysis, and research analyst leadership. 

Role Overview

Futurum Research is seeking a full-time Project Manager
(remote, based in the United States) to support the execution of select custom research and client-facing engagements. This role is ideal for someone who is accountable and proactive when operating in new, evolving areas; who excels at managing streamlined, fast-turn projects; and who maintains a high standard of client experience and operational rigor.

The Project Manager will oversee the delivery of analyst-authored research projects for technology vendors that may include, but are not limited to: thought leadership briefs and reports, customer case studies, competitive and market intelligence readouts, business cases, and other survey-based market research. They may manage survey questionnaire development, fielding, and guide projects from survey design to data collection, analysis, and final content writing and delivery. They will also manage analyst speaking engagements, content and publication programs, and provide general PM administrative support (e.g., project and project channel setup, reporting). 

Success in this role requires strong communication skills, comfort in client-facing situations, and the ability to keep projects moving efficiently from intake through delivery. As Futurum is a quickly changing and growing business, the environment and projects may be evolving and will not always be fully defined, templated, or standardized. The PM must be proactive, ambitious, and confident in pushing projects forward, making the necessary judgments, and escalating to the team and leadership for support when needed. new_jobs.title: Enterprise Asset Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100705

Position Overview

The Enterprise Asset Program Manager is responsible for implementing, operationalizing, and owning Autodesk's enterprise hardware asset management capability across PCs, Macs, mobile phones, and other end-user hardware. This role serves as the accountable owner for establishing accurate, governed asset data as the trusted system of record across the full lifecycle, from catalog and standards definition through governance, financial strategy, and cross-departmental asset architecture.

This is a hands-on role. The person in this seat will personally build and operate these processes, carrying forward and executing on recommendations from a recent external assessment of Autodesk's fulfillment, distribution, and ITAD practices, not simply direct others toward them. The role is structured as an individual contributor today; prior experience leading people or cross-functional programs is valued for how someone approaches ownership and accountability, even without direct reports in this seat.

This role owns asset management for a global population of approximately 21,500 employees and contingent workers, covering an estimated 60,000+ devices across computers, mobile phones, and loaner and spare inventory. The role oversees a significant, multi-million dollar annual hardware program and is accountable for continuing this function's demonstrated track record of cost discipline and savings.

Responsibilities

Asset Program Architecture and Governance

Define the program's strategy, roadmap, and operating model, including cross-functional roles and governance cadences with Finance, Procurement, and Security, moving the program from initial implementation into stable, ongoing operations
Establish and enforce a hardware governance framework, including a governance board, ensuring standards stay current against the market and defined personas
Own and mature the customization and exception governance process for requests outside standard catalog offerings
Work across departments that use end-user hardware in an advisory and architectural capacity, including managing global VAR vendor relationships

Catalog and Standards

Define and implement persona-based hardware standards and device catalog tiers, informed by industry practice
Evaluate customization and upgrade requests on technical merit, distinguishing genuine need from preference
Build a compliance and security vetting process for new hardware models with the security team

Lifecycle Operations and Data Accuracy

Establish consistent controls across the full hardware lifecycle, from request and procurement through deployment, recovery, refresh, and secure disposal
Personally drive improvement of current asset database accuracy (approximately 60-70 percent today) and establish standards for data matching, reconciliation, and quality
Integrate asset management with discovery, endpoint management, identity, CMDB, procurement, and disposition systems, and align asset data with core ITSM processes
Drive automation of asset tracking and reconciliation workflows to reduce manual effort

Financial Strategy

Lead hardware asset financial planning, including budgeting, forecasting, and spend analysis, with CapEx versus OpEx fluency
Own financial reconciliation against purchasing, accounts payable, the fixed-asset register, and general ledger, resolving variances in cost, ownership, and capitalization
Develop and report on asset management KPIs and dashboards for senior leadership

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum 7 years of experience owning enterprise asset management programs end-to-end. Not just project managing them, but accountable for outcomes and deliverables over multiple years, and can speak to this experiences
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in a relevant field
Demonstrated experience operating at large enterprise scale (e.g., 50,000+ managed assets), including the systems, process rigor, and stakeholder complexity that scale requires
Hands-on experience with CMDB/ServiceNow data integration, including data hygiene, accuracy, and governance practices across device- and asset-level records
Demonstrated ability to manage the full asset lifecycle (procurement, provisioning, refresh, redeployment, disposition) across device types, including mobile devices
Experience setting up or operating within formal change management processes (e.g., ITIL change/release management)
An engineering mindset toward process and systems: comfortable applying structured, repeatable approaches to workflow design and systems integration
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and contract or vendor cost management
Ability to build and present materials for senior leadership, including governance documentation (RACI, SLAs, XLAs) and program status/metrics
Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with HR, Finance, Procurement, Security, and technical stakeholders
People leadership or management experience is a plus but not required for this role
Comfortable operating globally across time zones and driving change across regionally distributed teams
Experience with AI toolsets as its related to assets, systems, and asset data (CIs, etc.) a plus

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Security & IAM
new_jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You'll Do

The Product Engineering organization is responsible for executing and delivering CoreWeave's products, platforms, processes, and tools. As a security technical program leader focused on enterprise security and Identity & Access Management (IAM), you will work across cross-functional teams—including security, IT, engineering, product, and operations—to ensure that access to our cloud infrastructure and enterprise systems is secure, governed, and least-privileged, while maintaining scalability and delivery of exceptional performance to meet the demands of our customers.

If you are passionate about identity, access, and cloud security, thrive in complex technical environments, and excel at orchestrating large-scale programs, we want to hear from you!

About The Role

Lead end-to-end program management for critical enterprise security and IAM initiatives—including identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, and privileged access—across cross-functional planning, execution, delivery, and retrospectives
Define program scope, milestones, and success metrics while managing security and identity-related risks and dependencies
Partner closely within the security team, and across IT, engineering, product management and operations teams to ensure alignment on identity and access priorities and deliverables
Act as the primary point of contact for security and cross-functional stakeholders, providing regular status updates, addressing risks, and ensuring accountability
Facilitate and influence technical discussions and decisions on identity, access, privacy and compliance to align with long-term infrastructure goals and business objectives
Develop and implement scalable processes—such as access certification, joiner/mover/leaver workflows, and least-privilege reviews—to improve efficiency and predictability in program delivery
Strategically automate and improve day-to-day identity operations, processes and reporting
Tailor communications to a diverse audience and remain adaptable to a wide range of personalities and technical depth

Who You Are

8+ years of hands-on Technical Program Management experience, with a strong focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM), enterprise security, or identity governance programs, ideally within the cloud services or SaaS industry.
A Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent job experience.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale IAM initiatives—such as identity lifecycle management (joiner/mover/leaver), single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), privileged access management (PAM), role-/attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC), and access certification/recertification campaigns.
Working knowledge of core IAM and identity governance platforms and protocols (e.g., Okta, Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP) and Zero Trust architecture principles and least-privilege access models across workforce and workload identities.
Exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to build relationships across technical and non-technical teams.
Proficiency in program management tools and methodologies (e.g., Jira, Google Sheets) with a focus on delivering measurable results.
Proven track record in process definition, process improvement, and driving adoption of defined processes across multiple teams or organizations.
Ability to lead cross-functional teams to prioritize, manage tradeoffs, identify gaps and risks, drive accountability, and operating autonomously across multiple teams and organizations.

Preferred

Understanding of identity governance and administration (IGA), entitlement management, secrets management, and workload/machine identity in cloud-native environments.
Familiarity with networking, storage, containerization (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines, and how identity and access controls integrate across them.
Experience partnering with IT, security engineering, and platform teams to deliver identity infrastructure at scale.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and flexible working with a variety of leadership styles.

Wondering if you're a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.

Why CoreWeave?

About

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

Be Curious at Your Core
Act Like an Owner
Empower Employees
Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. The organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $157,000 to $210,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave
Company-paid Life Insurance
Voluntary supplemental life insurance
Short and long-term disability insurance
Flexible Spending Account
Health Savings Account
Tuition Reimbursement
Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health
Family-Forming support provided by Carrot
Paid Parental Leave
Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside
401(k) with a generous employer match
Flexible PTO
Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations
A casual work environment
A work culture focused on innovative disruption

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) , CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Overview

Seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead a cross-functional digital management support team for the General Services Administration (GSA) Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO). This role serves as the primary point of contact for the Contracting Officer (CO) and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), ensuring successful delivery across three task areas: Application and Enterprise Architecture, Financial Operations and FinOps, and AI and Data Governance.

Responsibilities

Provide overall program leadership, direction, and oversight for a 12-month base + two 12-month option period FFP task order.
Manage day-to-day operations, staffing, and deliverables across all task areas.
Serve as the primary liaison between the contractor team and GSA government personnel (CO, COR, and program office).
Develop and maintain the Project Plan, including timeline, milestones, and quality processes.
Facilitate the Kick-off Meeting within 7 business days of award.
Submit Monthly Status Reports by the 10th of each month, including progress, schedule, issues, corrective actions, and personnel status.
Ensure all deliverables meet Federal accessibility standards (Section 508) and GSA requirements.
Lead agile project management and delivery methodologies.
Coordinate cross-functional integration, knowledge transfer, and best practice sharing across all task areas.
Manage risk, resolve performance issues, and ensure contract compliance.
Support key personnel substitution requests and ensure all personnel maintain required clearances.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in IT, Business, or related field (Master's preferred).
Minimum 10 years of experience managing federal IT programs, including FFP task orders.
PMP or equivalent certification required.
Demonstrated experience with agile project management and delivery.
Experience managing multiple diverse projects from planning through execution.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Active HSPD-12 clearance or favorable determination by contract award.

Preferred

Experience with GSA IT or similar federal agency.
Experience leading cross-functional teams in a remote environment.
Knowledge of GSA IT policies (CIO 2101.1, CIO 2130.2, CIO 2140.4).

Schedule & Work Conditions

Core Hours: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday, excluding Federal holidays.
Work Location: Primarily remote; occasional in-person meetings at GSA Headquarters (Theodore Roosevelt Building, 1900 E Street NW, Washington, DC) as requested by the COR.
Travel: Local travel within 50 miles of GSA sites in the Washington, DC metropolitan area is not reimbursable. No other travel is expected.
Telework: Ad hoc or situational telework is authorized with prior approval from the Task Order Contracting Officer. Telework reports must be submitted by the end of each telework day.
Security: Must maintain HSPD-12 credential and favorable background investigation throughout the life of the task order.

new_jobs.title: Director, Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
PayIt builds digital government experience and payments technology that helps state and local agencies serve residents the way modern consumers expect to be served – fast, mobile, and simple. Through PayIt Outdoors, the company partners with state wildlife, parks, and natural resources agencies to modernize hunting, fishing, boating, and outdoor recreation licensing, permitting, and e-commerce. As the Outdoors portfolio has grown across multiple state agency clients, the business needs a director-level program leader to make sure delivery scales without losing quality, transparency, or trust.

Our culture welcomes people who exhibit what we call “PayIt DNA”: High integrity, drive, grit, high aptitude, and team orientation. We are collaborative and passionate about the work we do to improve the lives of our government clients and the end users they serve. We have ambitious scaling goals, and we look for team members who are ready to roll up their sleeves, solve problems, and find new opportunities to win with our clients. And we have a lot of fun together.

About The Role:

The Director, Program Management is the connective tissue between PayIt's executive leadership, client executives, and the implementation, product, and engineering teams delivering for PayIt Outdoors clients. This person keeps the delivery engine running: an organized, predictable, and transparent way of shipping commitments across a portfolio of concurrent state agency engagements. They are equally comfortable in a steering committee with a state agency director and in a working session with an implementation lead debugging a launch blocker – and they know when each posture is needed.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a purely strategic one. The right person builds and runs the cadences, reporting, and governance that make a multi-client delivery portfolio predictable, while personally stepping in on the accounts and escalations that need it most.

What You'll Do:

Executive & Client Relationship Management

Serve as a senior escalation point and trusted advisor for PayIt Outdoors clients, building relationships with state agency executives and program sponsors.
Represent delivery status, risk, and roadmap in executive business reviews – both with clients and with PayIt's leadership team.
Translate between client priorities and internal delivery capacity, setting realistic expectations and holding the line on scope, timeline, and quality.

Cross-Functional Delivery Orchestration

Own end-to-end coordination across implementation, product, and engineering teams for every active PayIt Outdoors client engagement.
Identify dependencies and conflicts across the client portfolio early – shared engineering capacity, competing launch dates, overlapping resources – and resolve or escalate them before they become blockers.
Partner with product and engineering leadership to align the delivery roadmap with what has been committed to clients, and flag gaps in both directions.

Program Governance & the Delivery Engine

Design and run the operating cadence for the Outdoors delivery organization: status cycles, steering committees, risk reviews, and launch readiness gates.
Build and maintain a consistent, repeatable program management framework (RAID logs, status taxonomy, escalation paths, definitions of "on track," "at risk," and "red") so every account is tracked the same way.
Continuously improve the delivery process based on what breaks – turning one-off fire drills into permanent process fixes.
Develop a project reporting framework suitable for hybrid SaaS solutions that can be efficiently replicated across projects.

Reporting & Communication

Produce client-facing status reports and executive readouts that are accurate, timely, and honest about risk.
Build and maintain internal reporting (portfolio dashboards, delivery scorecards) that gives PayIt executives a real-time, trustworthy view of the entire Outdoors book of business.
Ensure reporting flows both ways: client-facing commitments are visible internally, and internal capacity/risk is reflected in what clients are told.

Risk & Issue Management

Maintain a live view of risk across the portfolio and drive mitigation plans, not just risk logs.
Lead root-cause reviews after missed dates or escalations, and ensure fixes stick.

Team Leadership

Mentor and, as the portfolio grows, manage a team of program and project managers; set the standard for how they run their accounts.
Hire, coach, and develop program management talent to keep pace with the growth of the Outdoors business.

What You’ll Bring:

8–12+ years of program or project management experience, including managing multiple concurrent, complex, client-facing implementations simultaneously.
Demonstrated ability to operate credibly with C-suite/executive stakeholders and with day-to-day project teams – you can run a steering committee and a stand-up in the same day.
A track record of building (not just following) delivery governance: reporting structures, status cadences, escalation frameworks, and portfolio-level visibility.
Experience working across product and engineering organizations, with enough technical fluency to understand delivery risk without needing it translated.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you can turn a messy delivery reality into a clear, confidence-building narrative for a client executive or a PayIt SVP.
A bias toward organization and follow-through – things don't fall through the cracks on your accounts.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; PMP, PgMP, or similar certification required.

Bonus Points For:

Experience with state or local government clients, GovTech, or regulated public-sector procurement and delivery environments.
Experience with outdoor recreation, licensing, permitting, DMV, or similar agency systems.
Experience scaling a PMO or delivery function through a period of client/portfolio growth.
Familiarity with delivery and reporting tooling such as Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Confluence, and BI/dashboarding tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

Why Work For Us:

Our mission matters. Your work will make life better for our government agency clients and the millions of residents they serve.
You’ll do some of the best work of your career here. We tackle complex challenges that are interesting to solve, and you’ll grow a ton working at PayIt
People are our most important resource. Everyone has a voice. Collaboration is our default setting. And we have fun together.
We #payitforward with our corporate volunteer program, serving the communities where we work and live
Competitive salaries, excellent benefits, remote-first working arrangements, and all the resources you will need to do your best work

What We Care About:

We hire high-aptitude, high-integrity people who are great communicators and want to be part of a growing team.

We’re about openness, integrity, accessibility and great communication.

We obsess over the usability of our products, sharing ideas with each other, and our commitments to the communities we serve

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

PayIt is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other basis protected by applicable law.

PayIt is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an email to the People Operations Team and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

NOTE: U.S. Citizens and all those authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. are encouraged to apply. We are unable to provide sponsorship in the United States at this time. PayIt participates in E-Verify. To learn more, click here. Canadian Citizens and those authorized to work in Canada without sponsorship are also encouraged to apply.

The Technical AI Program Manager connects the enterprise's growing demand for AI solutions with the technical and functional teams who deliver them. You'll also track AI spending and value delivered, giving the organization a clear basis for investment decisions. This role combines leadership, technical expertise, program management excellence, and organizational change management to accelerate AI adoption across the enterprise.
You bring real world computer science and engineering fundamentals and have shipped things — but you've grown into a well-rounded professional who holds your own with executives as easily as with architects. You pressure-test every request against what matters, not what's most interesting to build.

AI Strategy.
